JSDoc L9-19 preserved and folded into the native file header + the exported interface doc-comment (the 'focusable icon-only button', the usePinned re-order-pinned-first composition, and the pinned_items migration-000162 provenance are retained; 'fresh browser profile'/'localStorage' wording adapted to 'fresh app install'/'per-device stores' for native).

PinButtonProps interface L20-33 ported field-for-field: itemType:PinnedItemType (L22), itemId:string|number (L24), context?:string (L26), size?:'sm'|'md' (L28), showLabel?:boolean (L30) — each with its JSDoc verbatim. The web className?:string (L32) is re-expressed as style?:StyleProp<ViewStyle> (the Drawer-port convention) and documented as the native analogue of the className escape hatch, merged onto the Pressable at the same last position cn() appended it. Interface exported unchanged.

SIZE_CLASS L35-38 ('h-7 w-7 text-xs' / 'h-8 w-8 text-sm') -> styles.boxSm {height:28,width:28} / styles.boxMd {height:32,width:32}; the text-xs/text-sm font sizes in SIZE_CLASS were dead for the icon-only path (the SVG icon is sized by ICON_CLASS, the label always uses its own text-xs) and are not carried. ICON_CLASS L40-43 ('h-3.5 w-3.5' / 'h-4 w-4') -> styles.iconSm {fontSize:14,lineHeight:16} / styles.iconMd {fontSize:16,lineHeight:18} applied to the '★' glyph (14px/16px == the 3.5/4 Tailwind icon sizes).
Function signature + destructure L45-52 ported verbatim with the same defaults (size='sm' L49, showLabel=false L50). Return type annotated React.ReactElement.

Body L53-58 ported verbatim: useTranslation t -> useNativeTranslationFallback t (L53); const {data: pinned = []} = usePinned(itemType, context) (L54); const toggle = useTogglePin(itemType) (L55); idStr = String(itemId) (L57); isPinned = pinned.some(p => String(p.item_id) === idStr) (L58). The native usePinned returns the same useQuery result and PinnedItem.item_id is string, so the membership test is byte-identical.

Icon swap L60 (const Icon = isPinned ? PinOff : Pin) — lucide Pin/PinOff have no native module. The web conveys the pinned state with BOTH an icon swap (Pin<->PinOff) AND a tint flip (text-[var(--text-muted)] -> text-amber-300, L90-91). The established native vocabulary for this pin/favorite affordance is the tintable '★' glyph (cf. the LinearSidebar port's pin control + Favorites group), so both icons collapse to one '★' AppText glyph whose colour carries the state: colors.textMuted when unpinned, '#fcd34d' (amber-300) when pinned — preserving the web's primary muted->amber signal exactly. No monochrome pushpin glyph renders reliably/tintably across iOS/Android/Windows/macOS; the gold-star idiom reads unambiguously as 'pinned' both icon-only and beside the Pin/Pinned label. Documented in the file header.

tooltipLabel L61-63 ported verbatim: isPinned ? t('pin.unpin','Unpin') : t('pin.pin','Pin'). labelText computed once mirroring the L98-101 span branch: isPinned ? t('pin.pinned','Pinned') : t('pin.pin','Pin'). textColor derived once from isPinned ('#fcd34d' vs colors.textMuted). Every i18n key + default ('pin.unpin'/'Unpin', 'pin.pin'/'Pin', 'pin.pinned'/'Pinned') is preserved.

handleClick L65-73 -> handlePress: the web e.stopPropagation()/e.preventDefault() (L69-70, stopping the enclosing row's onClick) have no DOM-bubbling analogue — React Native's gesture-responder system grants the touch to the innermost Pressable so a parent row's onPress does not also fire; both calls are dropped and the rationale is kept as the inline comment (L67-68 intent preserved). The toggle.isPending early-return guard (L71) and toggle.mutate({itemId: idStr, context, pin: !isPinned}) (L72) are ported verbatim.
